name: Google Cloud
how_to_set: Billing > Budgets & alerts > Create budget: scope this project, monthly amount, alerts at 50/90/100%.
In the same budget, connect a Pub/Sub topic; deploy the billing-disable function from infra/budgets/gcp (Terraform).
Test it once with DRY_RUN=true by publishing a fake over-budget message, then set DRY_RUN=false.
kill_switch: Cloud Function on the budget Pub/Sub topic unlinks billing from the project; this stops all paid services and can delete resources.
traps: Cloud Run or functions with min-instances above 0
Idle static IPs and Cloud NAT
BigQuery on-demand queries scanning whole tables
Unrestricted API keys (Maps, Gemini) abused after a leak
